title: Portfolio shows yesterday's values

acceptableCauses.mechanism: The overnight nav-import job in market-data-service (23:30 IST, 2026-10-13) aborted on a parse error and wrote 0 NAVs, so fund values still use the 2026-10-12 NAVs.

partialCredit.reason: Right pipeline, wrong side: the feed was delivered; our import failed.
Names the failed job but attributes it to the scheduler.

requiredEvidence.description: NAV age metric showing staleness since the failed import

keyCounterevidence: nav_age_s was already past 24 h and climbing well before the 09:10 IST portfolio-service deploy; the deploy only changed latency slightly.
NAV lookups report nav_date=2026-10-12, i.e. the previous import's data.
redHerrings: past incident: AMFI published NAVs late
